integrity: The proof exhausts primes, prime squares, and squarefree semiprimes. The prime and prime-square cases reduce to immediate coprimality divisibility contradictions. The semiprime harmonic quotient lies strictly between 1 and 4, leaving only values 2 and 3; these reduce to the exact factor equations (x-1)(y-1)=2 and (x-3)(y-3)=12. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the multiplicity range Omega(n)<=2. It does not settle existence of k-harmonic numbers for k>=2 or classify the Omega=3 layer. The original 1998 Cohen--Deng article was identified bibliographically but full text was not available through the inspected open routes, so possible prior appearance of the low-Omega observation remains a residual originality risk. The exact structured date uses the earliest day-resolved public source inspected; the older 1998 article was available only with year/issue granularity.
title: The first multiplicity layer of generalized Ore harmonic numbers
